title: Support call: wrong charge on an invoice

lines.text: Hi, I was charged twice for the same order and nobody has answered my emails.
lines.name: Ben

lines.text: I am sorry about that Ben. Can you give me the order number?
Yes, it is order 77120. The card was charged on the third and again on the fifth.
lines.name: Ben

lines.text: I can see both charges. The duplicate one is 85 dollars and it was not meant to happen.
I will escalate this to the billing team today and write down your case number.
How long will the refund take to show on my card?
lines.name: Ben

lines.text: That depends on your bank, I will find out what the usual time is.
Also my card reader at the shop keeps freezing. Is that connected?
lines.name: Ben

lines.text: No, that is a separate device problem. Which model is it?
It is the older grey one from two years ago.
lines.name: Ben

lines.text: In that case we should replace the card terminal, I will not try to repair it.
I will email you the return label for the old terminal after this call.

promises.what: escalate to the billing team today
email the return label for the old terminal
